title: Readout-Rank Laws for Isotropic Quantum Tangents
summary: Deep parameterized quantum circuits may remain sensitive to a parameter change while the observables retained by a learning model barely respond. We study this separation for a fixed computational-basis measurement. For a pure-state tangent, we compare the quantum Fisher information $F_Q$, the Fisher information $F_{\rm full}$ in the complete bitstring distribution, and the largest variance-normalized response $\mathcal I_{\mathcal A}$ available to a diagonal readout space $\mathcal A$.
